manifest.name: Storage
manifest.description: PersistentVolumes, claims and StorageClasses: overview, creation wizards, snapshots and volume expansion.

classes.title: StorageClasses
classes.emptyHint: Claims can only bind to existing PersistentVolumes until a class provisions them.
classes.defaultHint: Claims without a class get this one
classes.extraDefaultHint: Also marked default, but a newer default class applies

pvcs.title: PersistentVolumeClaims
pvcs.emptyNamespaceHint: Nothing in {{namespace}}; pick another namespace or create a claim.

expand.title: Expand {{name}}
expand.description: Now {{current}} (class {{storageClass}}). Volumes can only grow; the driver expands the volume and, for file systems, resizes it when a Pod mounts it.

blocked.not_bound: Only a Bound claim can be expanded
blocked.no_class: The claim has no StorageClass, so it cannot be expanded
blocked.class_missing: The claim's StorageClass does not exist
blocked.not_allowed: The StorageClass does not set allowVolumeExpansion

fields.name: Name
fields.accessModesHelp: RWO: one node read-write; ROX: many nodes read-only; RWX: many nodes read-write; RWOP: a single Pod.
fields.volumeModeHelp: Filesystem mounts a file system; Block hands the raw device to the Pod.
fields.reclaimPolicyHelp: Retain keeps the data after the claim is deleted; Delete removes the volume.

wizard.valid: Valid: the cluster accepted the object in a dry run.

pvc.title: New PersistentVolumeClaim
pvc.classHelp: Omitting the class lets the cluster's default apply; "None" binds only to volumes without a class.
pvc.bindHelp: Class, size and access modes must fit the volume; they are filled in from it.
pvc.cloneHelp: The CSI driver copies the claim's data; the clone must be at least as large.
pvc.restoreHelp: A new volume is created from the snapshot's data.

pv.title: New PersistentVolume
pv.classHelp: Claims bind to the volume only when they request this class; leave empty for none.
pv.driverHelp: An installed CSIDriver or a known one.
pv.volumeHandleHelp: The ID of the existing volume in the storage system.
pv.fsTypeHelp: Leave empty for the driver's default.
pv.hostPathTypeHelp: What must exist at the path before the volume is mounted.
pv.nodesRequired: A local volume lives on a node: Pods using it are scheduled there.
pv.nodesOptional: Optional: pins Pods using the volume to these nodes.

class.title: New StorageClass
class.provisionerHelp: The CSI driver or provisioner that creates volumes for this class.
class.parametersHelp: Passed to the provisioner; their meaning depends on it.
class.reclaimHelp: What happens to a provisioned volume when its claim is deleted.
class.bindingHelp: WaitForFirstConsumer provisions where the first Pod is scheduled (zone-aware); Immediate provisions at once.
class.expansionHelp: Lets claims of this class grow later.
class.defaultHelp: Claims without a class get this one.
class.replacesDefault: {{name}} is the default now. Claims without a class get the newest default, so remove the mark from {{name}} if this class replaces it.

validation.dnsSubdomain: must be lower-case letters, digits, '-' and '.', starting and ending with a letter or digit (at most 253)
validation.dnsLabel: must be lower-case letters, digits and '-', starting and ending with a letter or digit (at most 63)
validation.quantity: must be a quantity such as 10Gi or 500Mi
validation.accessModesRequired: name at least one access mode
validation.accessModeTwice: an access mode is listed twice
validation.rwopAlone: ReadWriteOncePod cannot be combined with other access modes
validation.labelValue: the value of "{{key}}" is not a valid label value
validation.driver: must be a qualified name such as ebs.csi.aws.com or example.com/driver
validation.absolutePath: must be a clean absolute path such as /mnt/data
validation.nfsServer: must be a host name or IP address
validation.fsType: must be a file system type such as ext4 or xfs
validation.mountOption: options cannot be empty or contain spaces
validation.bindAndClone: a claim bound to an existing volume cannot be cloned as well
validation.oneSource: set exactly one of hostPath, nfs, local or csi
validation.noBlock: hostPath and NFS volumes cannot be raw block devices
validation.localNodes: a local volume lives on one node: pick the node(s) it is on
validation.nfsNodes: an NFS volume is reachable from every node and takes no node affinity

awsEbs.note: EBS volumes live in one availability zone; WaitForFirstConsumer creates them in the Pod's zone.

params.type: Volume type: gp3 (default), gp2, io1, io2, st1 or sc1
params.fstype: File system created on the volume

gcePd.note: Persistent Disks are zonal unless replication-type is regional-pd.

params.type: Disk type: pd-balanced, pd-ssd, pd-standard or hyperdisk-balanced
params.replication: none, or regional-pd for a disk replicated across two zones
params.fstype: File system created on the disk

azureDisk.note: Managed disks attach to one node at a time (ReadWriteOnce).

params.skuName: Disk SKU: Premium_LRS, StandardSSD_LRS, Standard_LRS, PremiumV2_LRS, …
params.cachingMode: Host caching: None, ReadOnly or ReadWrite
params.fstype: File system created on the disk

longhorn.note: Longhorn replicates every volume across nodes; ReadWriteMany is served over NFS.

params.replicas: Number of replicas of each volume
params.staleTimeout: Minutes before a failed replica is cleaned up

localPath.note: Creates a directory on the node the Pod lands on; volumes cannot be expanded or moved.

params.nodePath: Base directory on the node (when the provisioner's config allows it)

noProvisioner.note: Provisions nothing: claims bind to PersistentVolumes created by hand, e.g. local disks.

csiHostpath.note: The Kubernetes CSI test driver: volumes are directories on one node; supports snapshots, clones and expansion.

csiNfs.note: Creates a sub-directory per volume on an existing NFS export.

params.server: NFS server host name or IP
